nom: RMS Beauty SuperNatural Radiance Serum Broad Spectrum SPF 30 Sunscreen

segments.dry: Reviewers with dry skin report the serum is not drying despite mineral/zinc content, and one pairs it with a facial oil first to avoid tightness.
segments.sensitive: Reviewers with sensitive skin report it does not irritate, sting, or worsen their sensitivity, and one specifically avoids the burning/stinging they get from other sunscreens.
segments.mature: Reviewers describing mature or aging skin (mid-40s to late 50s) report it gives glow and a smooth, hydrated look without settling into fine lines, though one notes 30 SPF feels insufficient for her needs.
segments.oily: One reviewer with oily, textured, acne-prone skin reports a natural even glow without added greasiness or breakouts, though another (skin type unspecified) reports some breakouts with consecutive daily use.

concerns.aging: Reviewers with mature or aging skin report it smooths texture and fine lines and gives a hydrated, natural glow instead of sitting in creases; some appreciate not needing full-coverage foundation anymore.
concerns.dehydration: Reviewers describe the serum as hydrating and non-drying, including one with dry skin who pairs it with a facial oil first; no reports of it causing dryness.
concerns.redness: Two reviewers say it visibly tones down redness and evens out red areas on the skin.
concerns.barrier: No reviewer specifically frames results in terms of barrier repair or damage.
concerns.spots: One reviewer notes it does not cake or gather in pores or fine lines, and several say it blurs imperfections and age spots without heavy coverage.
concerns.blemishes: Most reviewers report no new breakouts, including one with acne-prone oily skin; however, one reviewer reports seeing some breakouts after consecutive days of use.
concerns.oiliness: Reviewers consistently describe it as non-greasy and lightweight, including one with oily skin who says it does not turn oily or 'gross' during wear.

aspects.libelle: Blends into skin without white cast
Limited shade range between light and medium
High price relative to bottle size

extraits.texte: This just makes my skin glow, and it works great as a primer. I put the beauty oil on first then the Supernatural Radiance Serum. So, it is not drying at all and I have dry skin. This is one of my favorite products from RMS!!!
Love wearing this SPF on non-makeup days. Goes on smoothly and is non-irritating for my very sensitive skin. Will purchase again

This is my 2nd purchase of this product. I have very sensitive skin. This does not effect my sensitivity at all. I feel it leaves my skin flawless and glowing. It leaves a healthy natural glow. Will definitely keep purchasing. And I am 58 yo!

I've used 3 bottles of this and I will keep repurchasing. It's the best glowy sunscreen. My skin is oily, textured and acne prone and this gives me a natural, more even looking glow while giving the sun protection I need and not getting gross and oily. Beautiful.

The medium aura shade is a little darker than I expected but it looks nice on. The glow is gorgeous although I do feel it accentuates my pores. I find I get a more flawless look with 100% Pure's BB cream. I was expecting zero breakouts but I have seen some with consecutive days of use. Still, I'm glad to have found something clean with spf!

extraits.titre: The Magic of Light Aura Supernatural Radiance Serum!
extraits.texte: I'm 59 with fair skin, and I recently purchased the Supernatural Radiance Serum in Light Aura. The older I get, the more my needs for my makeup foundation have really changed. Even in just the last couple of years, my primary goal of a foundation has changed, and I'm no longer primarily looking for coverage; I'm looking for products that leave me feeling well-hydrated with very little visible evidence of makeup on my skin. I've found that having texture and fine lines and age spots make traditional foundation way too obvious on the skin. I want my skin looking like my skin, MORE than I want complete coverage of dark spots and undereye circles (especially if it means SEEING my makeup as the price). That being said, comparing the (rms Supernatural Radiance) Serum to a couple of other similar products I've used (Supergoop and Kosas Dreambeam), the Serum is simply MAGICAL!! WOW! Does this look so lovely, and feel so amazing!! It provides this incredibly smooth finish to the skin, like nothing I've ever used before. I don't know how Rose Marie did it, create a lightweight, sheer product that actually EVENS out your complexion! And the glow. My goodness. The glow. But it's not sparkly, plus it really does provide such a beautiful finish. The only negatives I have to say: whyyyyy only 30 SPF???? 30 is just not enough for protection. I shouldn't have to feel like I need to wear something additional to bump up my SPF. It should be at the least 40 SPF. The other negative: for the categ

Pros: love the light fragrance, no white cast, feels light and lovely Cons: The plastic container is a nightmare to get product out of especially towards the end. Makes my eyes burn within an hour or so!!!;-(
